advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm whether alias-shaped filenames with >4-char extensions (e.g. `.markdown`) and no path prefix should also be rejected, or document that the path-separator lookbehind is the intended primary guard.
evidence: ABSENCE: no test covers a >4-char extension (`.markdown`) or a path-separator-free alias-shaped filename; the two added tests exercise `.md` (2 chars, caught) and a sentence-final dot only.
Acceptor semantics make this a false-accept vector: `_block_accepted` returns True if `_WORD_TRIPLE_ALIAS.search(text)` matches (scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py:139-145).
advisory.finding: The trailing-extension negative lookahead `(?!\.[a-z]{1,4}\b)` only matches 1-4 lowercase-letter extensions, so a bare (non-path-prefixed) alias-shaped filename with a longer or mixed extension (e.g. `robe-creek-zealot.markdown`) is not rejected by the extension arm; only the path-separator lookbehind would still catch it, which fails when the filename appears with no directory prefix.
scenarios: A comment/docstring citing a bare `some-design-doc.markdown` filename while also carrying a live raw SHA would scan green.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add two separate tests isolating each new rejector: (a) alias preceded only by a path separator with a non-extension suffix, and (b) alias with only a trailing '.ext' and no leading separator, so removing either regex branch fails a test.
evidence: Test fixture 'docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md Item 3.' has BOTH a leading '/' before 'sync-hardening-proposal' and a trailing '.md' (tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py:174-175)

ABSENCE: no test isolates a hyphen-triple preceded ONLY by a path separator with a non-extension suffix (e.g. 'src/sync-hardening-proposal ...'), and no test isolates a hyphen-triple with ONLY a trailing '.ext' and no leading separator (e.g. 'see sync-hardening-proposal.md' at line start). Dropping the lookbehind additions or the lookahead alone would leave both new tests green.
advisory.finding: The new path/extension rejection has two independent branches (preceding path-separator lookbehind and trailing file-extension lookahead), but the sole path-rejection test 'docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md' exercises BOTH at once — so removing either branch alone would not fail any test (regression blindness on each branch).
advisory.suggested_fix: Add test_a_leading_path_separator_alone_rejects (fixture 'src/sync-hardening-proposal here' + a live SHA, expect rc 1) and test_a_trailing_extension_alone_rejects (fixture 'see sync-hardening-proposal.md' at comment start + a live SHA, expect rc 1).
